recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is for FHIR-core. Do not reintroduce the old core extension file or add a core patch; any future concern about whether displayCategory should be constrained differently now belongs in the FHIR Extension Pack and should account for FHIR-43033's ElementDefinition-context decision.
issue_request: FHIR-29595 was Published/Persuasive for FHIR-core Questionnaire in R5. It reported that questionnaire-displayCategory described display text but had contextInvariant type!='display', which excluded display items; the expected correction was to stop prohibiting display items.
initial_application: The same defect was already captured by FHIR-25127 on the current core source line and applied by f0b7244ac8, changing the extension context invariant from type!='display' to type='display'. FHIR-29595 itself was applied on the R4B line by 0f9f03800b with the same one-line correction.
additional_context: Core later removed questionnaire extension definitions from R5 source in dd468d4f17, so the active FHIR-core checkout no longer owns structuredefinition-extension-questionnaire-displayCategory.xml. The current Extension Pack definition is the active source for the extension. Later Published FHIR-extensions issue FHIR-43033 reviewed questionnaire extension contexts; commit 59d4c2c removed displayCategory's contextInvariant while restoring ElementDefinition context because one contextInvariant could not safely cover both Questionnaire.item and ElementDefinition use.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. The erroneous core invariant is not present in current core source, the prior core source was corrected before removal, and the current Extension Pack state reflects a later final context review rather than an unapplied FHIR-29595 typo.

related_jiras.note: Older Published issue for the same incorrect displayCategory contextInvariant on the current core line; its commit applied the same correction.
